caption: The drawing depicts a single soft shoe or moccasin, predominantly white in color, positioned in the center of a plain, off-white background. The shoe features a rounded toe and a high, angled collar. The upper part of the shoe is adorned with decorative elements, including a circular pink and white rosette near the opening, edged in a light blue fringe. Along the front flap of the shoe is a diagonal row of green leaf motifs with small red circular shapes, possibly representing flowers or berries. Below this row, the toe area displays a cluster of intricately drawn floral designs in shades of red, pink, blue, and green, adding more ornamental detail. Fine lines show the seams and contours of the soft, pliable material, and the drawing is signed "Blakeley" in small script near the right edge. There are no other objects or background elements present.
title: Baby's Shoe
